sun.name: Sun
sun.short: The Sun shows your core identity, your vitality and what makes you shine.

moon.name: Moon
moon.short: The Moon shows your emotions, what makes you feel safe and your inner needs.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.short: Mercury shows how you think, speak and learn.

venus.name: Venus
venus.short: Venus shows what you love, what you value and how you seek harmony in relationships.

mars.name: Mars
mars.short: Mars shows what you go after, how you take action and where you direct your energy.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.archetype: Expansion, abundance, luck, wisdom: the planet of abundance.
jupiter.short: Jupiter shows where you grow, where your faith lies and where life opens up generously.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.short: Saturn shows where you carry responsibility, learn patience and grow stronger over time.

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.short: Uranus shows where you want to be different, free and open to sudden change.

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.short: Neptune shows your dreams, your intuition and the sensitive area where boundaries dissolve.

pluto.name: Pluto
pluto.short: Pluto shows where you go through deep change and discover your inner power.

northNode.name: North Node
northNode.short: The North Node shows your direction of growth: the path that moves you forward even when it feels unfamiliar.

southNode.name: South Node
southNode.short: The South Node shows familiar habits you already master, and where you may get stuck.

lilith.name: Lilith (Black Moon)
lilith.short: Lilith shows suppressed instincts and the part of you that refuses to submit.

chiron.name: Chiron
chiron.short: Chiron shows a sensitive wound, and the wisdom that lets you help others as you understand it.

partOfFortune.name: Part of Fortune
partOfFortune.short: The Part of Fortune shows where life flows more easily and where you find contentment.

asc.name: Ascendant
asc.short: The Ascendant shows how you present yourself to the world and the first impression you make.

mc.name: Midheaven
mc.short: The Midheaven shows your career direction, public role and what you want to be known for.

dc.name: Descendant
dc.short: The Descendant shows the qualities you seek in partners and learn through relationships.

ic.name: Imum Coeli
ic.short: The Imum Coeli shows your roots, your family and your inner refuge.

aries.name: Aries
aries.expression: In Aries this energy is expressed boldly, directly and with initiative: quick to start and frank to speak.

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.expression: In Taurus this energy is expressed calmly, patiently and steadily: it seeks stability, comfort and tangible results.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.expression: In Gemini this energy is expressed with curiosity, agility and sociability: it wants to learn, ask and share.

cancer.name: Cancer
cancer.expression: In Cancer this energy is expressed sensitively, caringly and protectively: it seeks emotional safety and closeness.

leo.name: Leo
leo.expression: In Leo this energy is expressed warmly, creatively and generously: it wants to be seen, loved and to create from the heart.

virgo.name: Virgo
virgo.expression: In Virgo this energy is expressed precisely, attentively and usefully: it wants to improve, organise and help.

libra.name: Libra
libra.expression: In Libra this energy is expressed gracefully, diplomatically and in balance: it seeks harmony, beauty and fairness.

scorpio.name: Scorpio
scorpio.expression: In Scorpio this energy is expressed deeply, intensely and loyally: it wants to get past the surface to the truth.

sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
sagittarius.expression: In Sagittarius this energy is expressed optimistically, openly and freely: it seeks meaning, travel and wide horizons.

capricorn.name: Capricorn
capricorn.expression: In Capricorn this energy is expressed seriously, purposefully and with endurance: it wants to build something solid, step by step.

aquarius.name: Aquarius
aquarius.expression: In Aquarius this energy is expressed originally, independently and with an eye on the future: it thinks differently and wants change together.

pisces.name: Pisces
pisces.expression: In Pisces this energy is expressed sensitively, dreamily and compassionately: it flows with intuition and longs for wholeness.

1.name: 1st house
1.expression: In the 1st house this theme shows clearly in your personality and how you present yourself.

2.name: 2nd house
2.expression: In the 2nd house this theme is lived through money, possessions, skills and self-worth.

3.name: 3rd house
3.expression: In the 3rd house this theme shows in communication, learning, siblings and your close surroundings.

4.name: 4th house
4.expression: In the 4th house this theme is lived through home, family, roots and a sense of inner security.

5.name: 5th house
5.expression: In the 5th house this theme shows in creativity, romance, children and the joy of living.

6.name: 6th house
6.expression: In the 6th house this theme is lived through daily work, habits, service and caring for your health.

7.name: 7th house
7.expression: In the 7th house this theme shows in partnerships, marriage and committed relationships.

8.name: 8th house
8.expression: In the 8th house this theme is lived through deep bonds, shared resources and life-changing crises.

9.name: 9th house
9.expression: In the 9th house this theme shows in travel, higher education, belief and worldview.

10.name: 10th house
10.expression: In the 10th house this theme is visible in your career, public reputation and life purpose.

11.name: 11th house
11.expression: In the 11th house this theme is lived through friendship, community, teamwork and hopes for the future.

12.name: 12th house
12.expression: In the 12th house this theme is lived in your inner world, in solitude, dreams and unseen processes.

conjunction.name: Conjunction
conjunction.meaning: The two energies merge and amplify each other.

opposition.name: Opposition
opposition.meaning: The two energies stand at opposite poles; the task is balance and seeing yourself in the other.

trine.name: Trine
trine.meaning: The two energies flow naturally together, giving talent and ease.

square.name: Square
square.meaning: There is tension between the two energies; the friction drives growth and action.

sextile.name: Sextile
sextile.meaning: The two energies support each other; the opportunity is there, but the step is yours to take.

quincunx.name: Quincunx
quincunx.meaning: The two energies don't quite understand each other; constant small adjustments are needed.

semisextile.name: Semi-sextile
semisextile.meaning: A light, subtle link; a chance for small adjustments.

semisquare.name: Semi-square
semisquare.meaning: Minor but persistent irritation; friction that asks for attention.

sesquiquadrate.name: Sesquiquadrate
sesquiquadrate.meaning: Hidden tension; a challenge that surfaces from time to time.

grandTrine.name: Grand Trine
grandTrine.meaning: Three planets form an equilateral triangle: natural talent and easy flow, with a risk of staying too comfortable.

tSquare.name: T-Square
tSquare.meaning: Two opposing planets put pressure on a third: the apex planet shows the main life challenge and its driving force.

grandCross.name: Grand Cross
grandCross.meaning: Four planets form a cross: tension from every side builds great endurance and strength.

yod.name: Yod (Finger of Fate)
yod.meaning: Two planets point at a third: the apex is a special mission and an area of constant adjustment.

kite.name: Kite
kite.meaning: A fourth planet joins a grand trine: talent gains a concrete direction and purpose.

mysticRectangle.name: Mystic Rectangle
mysticRectangle.meaning: Two oppositions joined by trines and sextiles: tension turns into practical harmony.

stellium.name: Stellium
stellium.meaning: Three or more planets gather in one place: this theme carries special weight in your life.

domicile.name: Domicile
domicile.meaning: The planet is in its own sign: its energy flows naturally and strongly.

exaltation.name: Exaltation
exaltation.meaning: The planet is exalted: its best qualities shine.

detriment.name: Detriment
detriment.meaning: The planet is opposite its own sign: expressing it takes extra effort.

fall.name: Fall
fall.meaning: The planet is in its fall: maturity in this area is earned over time.

1.name: The Magician
1.plus: Starting new things and inspiring people through words and ideas.
1.minus: Manipulation, scattered energy, starting without finishing.

2.name: The High Priestess
2.plus: Deep intuition, a gift for learning and teaching, trust in the inner voice.

3.name: The Empress
3.plus: Care, beauty, abundance and creative energy.

4.name: The Emperor
4.plus: Responsibility, building stability, leadership and decisiveness.

5.name: The Hierophant
5.plus: Passing on knowledge, giving spiritual direction, respect for family and tradition.
5.minus: Dogmatism, preaching, clinging to old rules.

6.name: The Lovers
6.plus: Loving from the heart, seeing beauty, making the right choice.

7.name: The Chariot
7.plus: Moving towards goals, travel, winning through will.

8.name: Justice
8.plus: Fairness, understanding cause and effect, clear decisions.
8.minus: Judging others, resentment, powerlessness before injustice.

9.name: The Hermit
9.plus: Deep thought, finding your own path, lighting the way for others.

10.name: Wheel of Fortune
10.plus: Openness to change, seeing chances, moving with the rhythm of life.
10.minus: Passivity, leaving everything to fate, instability.

11.name: Strength
11.plus: Great vital energy, mastering emotions, compassionate strength.

12.name: The Hanged Man
12.plus: Seeing the world differently, service, deep understanding.

13.name: Death
13.plus: Letting go of the old to make room for the new; the power to transform.
13.minus: Fear of change, clinging to the past, destructiveness.

14.name: Temperance
14.plus: Calm, adaptability, bringing harmony and healing to people.

15.name: The Devil
15.plus: Charisma, financial skill, using power well.
15.minus: Addictions, manipulation, giving in to desires.

16.name: The Tower
16.plus: Tearing down false structures and building anew, sincere creativity.
16.minus: Sudden crises, stubbornness, destroying what is around you.

17.name: The Star
17.minus: Fear of being seen, living in dreams.

19.name: The Sun
19.plus: Warmth, optimism, success and sharing energy with others.

20.name: Judgement
20.plus: Bond with the family, awakening, learning from past experience.
20.minus: Ancestral burdens, not forgiving, being stuck in the past.

21.name: The World
21.plus: A broad worldview, travel, going beyond borders.

22.name: The Fool
22.plus: Freedom, spontaneity, play and openness to the new.

A.name: Calling card
A.meaning: How others see you; your natural character.

B.name: Second half of character
B.meaning: Inner character, inspiration and potential talent.

C.name: Task until 40
C.meaning: The quality and material sphere to develop before 40.

D.name: Karmic task
D.meaning: The main lesson of the soul to work through.

E.name: Comfort zone
E.meaning: The heart of the matrix: the energy where you find harmony.

F.name: Father's line (spiritual)
F.meaning: Spiritual inheritance from the father's side.

G.name: Mother's line (spiritual)
G.meaning: Spiritual inheritance from the mother's side.

H.name: Father's line (material)
H.meaning: Material inheritance and programmes from the father's side.

I.name: Mother's line (material)
I.meaning: Material inheritance and programmes from the mother's side.

J.name: Personality
J.meaning: A personal quality close to the core.

L.name: Money channel
L.meaning: The channel through which money comes.

M.name: Readiness for relationships
M.meaning: Meeting a partner and readiness for a relationship.

N.name: Karmic tail (middle)
N.meaning: An unresolved task carried from the past.

S.name: Inner core
S.meaning: The quality that leads to the comfort zone.

T.name: Path to the heart
T.meaning: Spiritual talent expressed close to the core.

R.name: Love and money node
R.meaning: The main block and growth point in love and money.

R1.name: Character of the relationship
R1.meaning: The general tone of your partnerships.

R2.name: Profession and success
R2.meaning: The professional sphere that brings success.

F1.name: Father's line programme
F1.meaning: A programme passed down the father's line.

F2.name: Father's line talent
F2.meaning: A talent from the father's line.

G1.name: Mother's line programme
G1.meaning: A programme passed down the mother's line.

G2.name: Mother's line talent
G2.meaning: A talent from the mother's line.

H1.name: Father's line programme (material)
H1.meaning: A material programme from the father's side.

H2.name: Father's line, near centre
H2.meaning: The father's-line energy near the centre.

I1.name: Mother's line programme (material)
I1.meaning: A material programme from the mother's side.

I2.name: Mother's line, near centre
I2.meaning: The mother's-line energy near the centre.

L1.name: Combined centre
L1.meaning: The sum of the personal and ancestral centres.

L2.name: Ancestral centre
L2.meaning: The centre of the ancestral square.

earth.name: Earth line
earth.meaning: Material skills, showing up in the world.

personal.name: Personal purpose (age 20–40)
personal.meaning: Finding yourself, balancing sky and earth.

male.name: Male line
male.meaning: The influence of the father's line.

female.name: Female line
female.meaning: The influence of the mother's line.

social.name: Social purpose (age 40–60)
social.meaning: Your role in society, with family and people.

spiritual.name: Spiritual purpose (age 60+)
spiritual.meaning: The highest task of the soul.

sun.name: Sun (Surya)
sun.dasha: A period of self-confidence, father, authority, health and leadership.

moon.name: Moon (Chandra)
moon.dasha: A period of emotions, mother, home, comfort and public contact.

mars.name: Mars (Mangala)
mars.dasha: A period of energy, courage, land and property, siblings and competition.

mercury.name: Mercury (Budha)
mercury.dasha: A period of learning, trade, communication and intellectual work.

jupiter.name: Jupiter (Guru)
jupiter.dasha: A period of wisdom, growth, children, teachers and blessings.

venus.name: Venus (Shukra)
venus.dasha: A period of love, marriage, beauty, art and comfort.

saturn.name: Saturn (Shani)
saturn.dasha: A period of patience, duty, hard work, discipline and maturity.

rahu.name: Rahu (North Node)
rahu.dasha: A period of ambition, unusual opportunities, foreign links and sudden change.

ketu.name: Ketu (South Node)
ketu.dasha: A period of turning inward, spirituality, detachment and letting go.

lagna.name: Lagna (Ascendant)
lagna.dasha: Body, character and the starting point of the life path.

1.name: Leader
1.meaning: The energy that opens its own path, takes the first step and leads others.

2.name: Diplomat
2.meaning: Partnership, patience and the gift of bringing people together.

3.name: Creator
3.meaning: Self-expression through words, art and humour, spreading joy around.

4.name: Builder
4.meaning: The energy that builds solid foundations and works with plan and reliability.

5.name: Free spirit
5.meaning: A flexible energy open to the new, learning through travel and experience.

6.name: Nurturer
6.meaning: Care for family and people, and harmony at home.

7.name: Seeker
7.meaning: The energy that seeks truth, thinks deeply and grows strong in solitude.

8.name: Power
8.meaning: The ability to achieve goals, manage and build material success.

9.name: Humanitarian
9.meaning: A big heart, service to humanity, and letting go to complete a cycle.

11.name: Master 11 — Illuminator
11.meaning: Strong intuition and a mission to inspire others; a high-voltage but inspiring energy.

22.name: Master 22 — Master builder
22.meaning: The potential to turn big dreams into real, lasting works.

33.name: Master 33 — Master teacher
33.meaning: Guiding others with love and compassion; selfless service.

lifePath.name: Life path
lifePath.meaning: From the birth date: the main theme and direction of your life.

expression.name: Expression (destiny)
expression.meaning: From the full name: your talents and how you express yourself.

soulUrge.name: Soul urge
soulUrge.meaning: From the vowels of the name: your heart's deepest desire.

personality.name: Personality
personality.meaning: From the consonants of the name: how others see you.

birthday.name: Birthday
birthday.meaning: From the day of birth: a special talent.

maturity.name: Maturity
maturity.meaning: Life path + expression: potential that unfolds in the second half of life.

personalYear.name: Personal year
personalYear.meaning: The energy of this year: where you are in the 9-year cycle.

karmicDebt.13: Learning through effort: overcoming laziness and finishing what you start.
karmicDebt.14: Using freedom wisely: avoiding excess and dependency.
karmicDebt.16: Rebuilding the ego: from pride to humility.
karmicDebt.19: Learning independence the right way: being able to ask for help.

dayMaster.name: Day Master
dayMaster.meaning: You yourself: the core of the character.

sevenKillings.name: Seven Killings (Qi Sha)
sevenKillings.meaning: pressure, courage, a test of leadership

soul.name: Life palace
soul.meaning: Personality, character, the main theme of life.

wealth.name: Wealth
wealth.meaning: How money is earned and spent.

surface.name: Travel
surface.meaning: Life away from home, travel, public image.
